system.description:
Range 30ft; one creature that died within the last 1 minute per level; Will negates (its soul resists). On a failure the soul is drawn into a black sapphire worth 1,000 gp per HD of the dead creature (not consumed). While the gem is intact it cannot be returned by Reincarnate, Raise Dead, Resurrection, True Resurrection, Clone or Speak with Dead. Shattering the gem frees the soul; so does a Wish or Miracle.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Cleric, Necromancer, Witch
